content.label: After spending a couple years trying to talk to AI chatbots like Claude and ChatGPT, I became so frustrated I wanted to throw my phone or my computer out the damn window. They never could understand homophones, articles, and sometimes pronouns. It was just absolutely maddening. I had to go back and amend 90% of what I spoke. Wispr Flow makes it so much easier, and it's been a breeze to communicate in a variety of formats.
